text:
Aisha: Quick sync — we need to lock the webinar topic and rehearsal schedule by EOD. Preferences: 45m talk + 10m live demo + 15m audience Q&A. Thoughts?
Jon: 45/10/15 sounds good. keep the demo narrow (cost/perf comparison + 1 fallback).
Priya: Agree. Suggest title: 'Serving LLMs: Pragmatic Benchmarks & Failover Patterns' (too long?)
Aisha: I like it. Maybe shorten to 'Practical LLM Serving: Benchmarks & Failovers' — conveys both econ + reliability.
Marco: We should pick 3 short abstracts for marketing — speaker blurbs + 1-sentence TL;DR for registration page. I can draft.
Emilia: Note: need speaker confirmation for live demo — @Oliver can you run the demo on dedicated infra? we need a dry-run. :eyes:
Oliver: Yep, can do. Can we reserve a 30m slot for a tech check (SSH + model pull + firewall) the day before?
Aisha: Yes. Proposed timeline:
```
- Day -2: Tech check (30m) - infra + slides + demo env
- Day -1: Full dress rehearsal (60m) - run full flow end-to-end
- Show day: 15m pre-warm + 5m AV check + live session
```
Priya: Good. For abstracts: I'll draft 3 variants: (A) Product-first (how customers save $), (B) Engineering (runtime/ops patterns), (C) Case study (customer story + metrics). Which is highest priority?
Jon: Engineering and case study — they drive technical signups. Product-first can be a social post after.
Marco: I'll own the case-study copy, Priya can do the engineering one, Aisha you do the product-first social?
Aisha: Yep. Also need speaker slots: primary speaker (40m), co-presenter for demo (10m), moderator for Q&A. Oliver = demo, Jon available as moderator?
Jon: Happy to moderate. Can help triage audience questions live and pull in folks for deep answers.
Emilia: Reminder on rehearsal: capture recording and timestamp the demo segment for the on-demand clip. Also we should run the fallback demo (local container) in case Redwood Dedicated has a hiccup.
Oliver: Will prepare a dockerized fallback and a short runbook snippet: `docker run redwood/demo-proxy:stable --mode=local`
DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: reminder: reserve GPU queue for dress rehearsal on 2024-11-15 16:00 UTC.
Aisha: Thanks deploy bot. Oliver — can you confirm you'll test both hosted + fallback flows during the tech check?
Oliver: Confirmed. I'll also simulate a model cold-start + quantized variant to show cost tradeoffs.
Priya: For promotion: hero copy + 3 bullets (what you'll learn, who it's for, quick takeaways). I'll write hero copy and sample tweets.
Marco: We need CTA routing: self-serve signups -> marketing CRM; enterprise interest -> sales handoff. Who owns the lead routing playbook?
Aisha: Marco, can you own routing? Jon, coordinate with sales for the enterprise tag.
Marco: On it. I'll create tags: webinar:registrant, interest:dedicated, interest:private-deploy.
Emilia: Schedule rehearsal invites now — timezone notes: majority in NA/EU; pick Dress Rehearsal at 16:00 UTC to maximize overlap.
Aisha: Final asks: abstracts by tomorrow noon, speaker bios + headshots by EOD, demo checklist in repo by Friday. Any blockers?
Priya: Will submit abstract + slides outline by noon.
Oliver: Demo checklist PR by Friday morning.
Jon: I'll sync with sales and confirm moderator script.
Aisha: Great — I'll compile run-of-show draft and share for comments. :rocket:
Emilia: tiny nit — can we add 5m buffer after demo for live poll results? helps engagement.
Aisha: Good call. Adding 5m polling buffer. Updated show day flow: 45m talk, 10m demo, 5m poll, 15m Q&A.
Marco: Perfect. I'll draft the registration page copy and pass to design.
Aisha: Thanks team — will post the rehearsal calendar invites after abstracts come in. :sparkles:
